question: There are \(2n+1\) real numbers having the property that the sum of any \(n\) of them is less than the sum of the remaining \(n+1\). Then,

options.A: all the numbers must be positive
options.B: all the numbers must be negative
options.C: all the numbers must be equal
options.D: such a system of real numbers cannot exist.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
